mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, (SELECT gg.name FROM game_genres gg JOIN game_genre_relations gr ON gg.id = gr.genre_id WHERE gr.game_id = g.id ORDER BY gg.id LIMIT 1) AS genre, g.developer, g.release_date, g.rating, ug.play_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_records pr WHERE pr.user_id = ug.user_id AND pr.game_id = g.id) AS sessions, DATE(ug.last_played) AS last_played, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_achievements ua JOIN achievements a ON ua.achievement_id = a.id WHERE ua.user_id = ug.user_id AND a.game_id = g.id) AS achievements, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM achievements a WHERE a.game_id = g.id) AS total_achievements, ug.status, ug.notes AS note FROM user_games ug JOIN games g ON ug.game_id = g.id WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ug.last_played DESC, ug.id DESC

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, (SELECT gg.name FROM game_genres gg JOIN game_genre_relations gr ON gg.id = gr.genre_id WHERE gr.game_id = g.id ORDER BY gg.id LIMIT 1) AS genre, g.developer, g.release_date, g.rating, ug.play_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_records pr WHERE pr.user_id = ug.user_id AND pr.game_id = g.id) AS sessions, DATE(ug.last_played) AS last_played, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_achievements ua JOIN achievements a ON ua.achievement_id = a.id WHERE ua.user_id = ug.user_id AND a.game_id = g.id) AS achievements, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM achievements a WHERE a.game_id = g.id) AS total_achievements, ug.status, ug.notes AS note FROM user_games ug JOIN games g ON ug.game_id = g.id WHERE g.id = #{id} AND ug.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_games, COALESCE(SUM(play_time), 0) AS total_play_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_achievements ua WHERE ua.user_id = #{userId}) AS achievements, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '已完成' THEN 1 END) AS completed_games FROM user_games WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_games SET status = #{status}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = '已完成' THEN COALESCE(completed_at, NOW()) ELSE NULL END WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND game_id = #{gameId}
mapper.select: SELECT gg.name FROM game_genres gg JOIN game_genre_relations gr ON gg.id = gr.genre_id WHERE gr.game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY gg.id

SELECT ug.game_id AS game_id, gg.name AS name FROM user_games ug JOIN game_genre_relations gr ON ug.game_id = gr.game_id JOIN game_genres gg ON gr.genre_id = gg.id WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ug.game_id, gg.id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(duration) AS minutes FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND game_id = #{gameId} AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{offsetDays} DAY) AND start_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
